summary: Viridian Therapeutics filed a prospectus supplement for a 424B5 shelf takedown offering $225M aggregate principal amount of 1.75% convertible senior notes due 2032 (plus $25M over-allotment). Terms: 1.75% semiannual interest, maturity May 15, 2032, initial conversion price ~$24.65/share (40.5680 shares per $1,000 principal). Settlement in cash/stock at issuer's election. Redeemable from May 20, 2030 subject to stock price conditions; noteholders may require repurchase on a fundamental change. This is a routine capital-raising convertible note offering, not a special situation. No acquisition, activist, spin-off, or restructuring component. Watch for dilution upon conversion and potential stock price impact from the offering.
